run_evaluate_r_program: run the evaluator on an R robust regression program file to measure accuracy and outlier robustness
generate_regression_data_with_outliers: generate synthetic regression data with configurable outlier fraction and noise levels for testing
test_evaluate_function: test the evaluate async function by passing an R script path and checking returned metrics

summarize_evaluation_scoring: summarize how the evaluator scores R programs across MSE, MAE, R-squared, and outlier robustness
